name: Nell, Master of Frost
desc:
Nell is an Adret NPC who acts as both the Frostdraw trainer and progression for the Silentheart Oath.

In order to obtain Frostdraw, you must bring 5 Frigid Prisms to Nell. (Note: You'll only need 2 Frigid Prisms if it's your first attunement obtained manually.) Alternatively, if you have obtained the Silentheart Oath, you must kill them in order to get one of six Oath Talents. They are found near the guildhouse (follow the path to the right) in [Etris](location:etris).
additional_info:
-   Both they and [Funke](entity:funke_master_of_thunder) don the Black Diver outfit. According to Arch\_Mage, they are most likely Black Divers.
    -   If they are indeed [Divers](faction:the_divers), this would make then and Funke two of the oldest, physically, known Divers, as they are the only Divers with wrinkles, excluding Coldheart Fortinbras.
-   Their eyes are unique, having a dark blue sclera similar to that of the Hallowtide variant of the Adret aspect. The only ottheirNPC that shares these eyes is Coldheart Fortinbras.
-   Nell is equipped with a Gran Sudaruska. As there was only one Sudaruska, only one Gran Sudaruska exists, seemingly implying Nell wields _the_ Gran Sudaruska. In reality, this is a case of Gameplay and Story Segregation, having it for the games' sake; being so they have a unique, legendary weapon when they're fought.
-   Nell used to have Rapid Punches before the NPC Mantra changes.
-   Unlike most Attunement Trainers, they can be aggroed, seen during the Etris Raid event occasionally fighting off Authority troops if they somehow get to her.
